held.reason: C-7 — one record deliberately expected not to publish. Its IN_CATEGORY relation names a category whose norm_v1 key equals the record code, which GKS would resolve to one entity and hold as invalid_endpoint. genesisrag17-parser-2 mirrors that guard at Stage 2, so the real chain refuses it there: the documented outcome is a terminal Stage 2 failure and no publication, never a false PASS.
